metadata.author: Rachael Harrington
metadata.description:
The Fairy Tale Art Cart is an interactive draw-along podcast where kids get to become the illustrators of the stories they hear! 

Each episode features a folktale from around the world that pauses for music-filled drawing breaks, inviting imaginations to run wild as scenes and characters are brought to life with simple art materials. 

Art teacher turned globe-trotting professional storyteller Rachael Harrington hosts the show with warmth, humor, and oodles of imagination.
